label: EXPLORATORY_POST_HOC_RESEARCH
prior_information: V1/V2 failed Validation and consumed failure-forensics results were already known. This internal lock limits this round's discretion; it is not a scientific time anchor.

targets.relative: raw_forward_return minus same-date mean over the identical fixed 30 industries
targets.missing: NO_FILL_NO_INDUSTRY_DROPS; incomplete feature or target cross-sections are excluded with reason counts

hypotheses: Recent industry winners may underperform recent losers over H5 and H10 (short-term reversal).
Relative versus absolute reversal differs in level but subtracting a common same-date mean cannot change cross-sectional ranks.
H5 and H10 may have different signs or decay; neither horizon is selected or fused.
Two transparent features may be easier to explain than the frozen 19-factor multi-horizon model; extra Ridge complexity must earn stable paired gains.

specifications.name: REV5
specifications.definition: negative arithmetic mean of the last 5 daily industry returns, including T; fixed positive direction

specifications.name: REV10
specifications.definition: negative arithmetic mean of the last 10 daily industry returns, including T; fixed positive direction

specifications.name: EQUAL_REV
specifications.constant_component: zero centered component; never choose a substitute

specifications.name: TWO_FACTOR_RIDGE
specifications.training_window: [T minus 24 calendar months, T minus H exchange sessions] inclusive; all training dates < T; label maturity <= T
specifications.objective: mean squared training error + 10 * squared standardized coefficients

specifications.name: FROZEN_V2_H10_REFERENCE
specifications.definition: read only already consumed, hash-pinned H10 predictions in existing failure-forensics replay

rank_contract: SPEARMAN_AVERAGE_TIES; top and bottom ties independently use ascending industry code; overlapping tied groups have null spread; zero-score rankings are undefined

dependence.overlap: H5/H10 daily forward windows overlap; no IID standard errors or p-values
dependence.assumption: approximate local stationarity within adjacent sessions; four-block regime variation can invalidate a global interval

correlations: pooled relative REV5/REV10/Y5/Y10 on common mature dates and mean daily cross-sectional correlations; disclose duplicated dates/dependence

regimes.label: POST_HOC_DESCRIPTIVE
regimes.trend: sign of trailing 20-session equal-weight industry mean compounded return through T
regimes.dispersion: trailing 20-session mean cross-sectional daily return standard deviation versus expanding median of that statistic strictly before T
regimes.groups: all four trend-sign x high/low-dispersion states
regimes.leadership: contemporaneous top5 list persistence; descriptive only

decision_rule.label: EXPLORATORY_RECOMMENDATION_HEURISTIC_NOT_VALIDATION
decision_rule.D: actual access or quality prevents a valid historical numerical run
decision_rule.A: both fixed S1 and S2, at both H5 and H10, have positive mean and median RankIC and positive raw signed spread, at least 3/4 positive blocks, and all 30 leave-one-out mean RankICs positive; recommend only future independent preregistration
decision_rule.B: A is not met but at least one fixed single-factor signal has positive mean RankIC at both horizons; seek more independent evidence rather than promote a model
decision_rule.C: neither fixed single-factor signal has positive mean RankIC at both horizons; the present short-horizon reversal hypothesis is not supported
decision_rule.ridge: paired complexity comparison is reported; learned sign reversals never silently redefine the reversal hypothesis or create a formal candidate

publication: ONLY_AGGREGATES_AND_SIX_WATERMARKED_CHARTS; per-date scores, labels, fits and source bytes remain private outside Git
